policies.name: Original recipient lock
policies.description: Refunds may only return to the recipient attached to the original payment.

policies.name: Refund amount boundary
policies.description: A refund cannot exceed the captured payment amount.

policies.name: High-value approval
policies.description: Refunds above ₹1,000 require a human decision before execution.

policies.name: One refund per customer per day
policies.description: A customer cannot receive more than one refund in a rolling demo day.

policies.name: Bounded payment links
policies.description: Payment links must be ₹5,000 or less and include an expiry.

policies.name: Contact frequency cap
policies.description: At most two recovery messages may be sent for a case.

policies.name: Stop after success
policies.description: Recovery links and messages must stop once the payment is successful.

policies.name: Untrusted-instruction isolation
policies.description: Financial actions derived from detected prompt injection are blocked unless explicitly pre-authorized.

policies.name: Idempotent execution
policies.description: The same business action and event may execute no more than once.

policies.name: Fresh-state revalidation
policies.description: Case state is fetched again immediately before a consequential action executes.
